failure_patterns.pattern: rule_ignored: Answers selected a nearby entity or an over-specific/noncanonical form despite existing rules to follow the requested slot, clue relations, granularity, and name form.

rejected_edits.content: - When a clue describes changing a word in a title or phrase, determine whether it asks for the altered form or the source form. If it asks for the original or identifies the referenced work, reverse the stated change and give the canonical source title, not the parody or modified title.
rejected_edits.target: - For a Spoonerism clue, identify the swapped sounds and restore them to recover the intended expression. Return that expression rather than the person or entity it refers to, unless the question explicitly asks for that entity.
